blocks.text: Pinehurst is a small community in the Canadian province of Nova Scotia, located along the LaHave River between New Germany and Wentzell's Lake in Nova Scotia. It is a stopping place on Trunk 10, which runs from Bridgewater to Middleton.

Pinehurst Lake is a lake in Northeastern Alberta. Located 245 kilometres (152 mi) northeast of Edmonton, in the Lakeland Provincial Recreation Area just east of the Lakeland Provincial Park, it is a popular destination for anglers and hunters alike.
